body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, November 23, 2026 – Immunic, Inc.** **(Nasdaq: IMUX)** , a late-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of novel oral therapies for neurologic diseases, today announced that from November 9, 2026 to November 23, 2026, the Compensation Committee of Immunic’s Board of Directors granted inducement equity grants covering an aggregate of 359,250 shares of common stock of the company under the Immunic, Inc. 2026 Inducement Equity Compensation Plan (the “Options”) to eight new employees. The Options were granted as an inducement material to the commencement of employment pursuant to NASDAQ Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). The Options will be time-vested, subject to each such employee’s continued employment on each vesting date.


**About Immunic, Inc.**
Immunic, Inc. (Nasdaq: IMUX) is a late-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of novel oral therapies for neurologic diseases. The company’s lead investigational asset, vidofludimus calcium (IMU-838), is currently being evaluated in Phase 3 clinical trials in relapsing multiple sclerosis, with top-line data expected to be available in December 2026. Initiation of an additional Phase 3 clinical trial in progressive multiple sclerosis is ongoing, with first-patient-enrolled expected in the first half of 2027. Vidofludimus calcium combines potential neuroprotective effects associated with nuclear receptor-related 1 (Nurr1) activation with anti-inflammatory and anti-viral effects associated with selective inhibition of the enzyme dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (DHODH). The company’s development pipeline also includes earlier-stage programs, including IMU-381 and IMU-856, aimed at building a broader therapeutics platform addressing neurodegenerative and autoimmune diseases. For further information, please visit:[www.imux.com](http://www.imux.com/) .
